user.title: Connect Modbus USB Controller
user.description: Configure the serial port settings and Modbus slave address for your USB-connected device.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the integration reads values from the Modbus device. Lower values mean faster updates but more serial bus traffic.
data_description.slave_id: The Modbus RTU slave address of your device. Check your device manual.

abort.already_configured: This port/slave ID combination is already configured.

menu_options.add_entity: Add a sensor, switch, binary sensor, or number

settings.title: Poll settings
settings.description: Adjust how often Modbus registers are polled.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the integration reads values. Range: 1–3600 seconds.

add_entity.title: Add entity
add_entity.description: Choose the entity type to create. Sensors and numbers read register values; switches write to coils or registers; binary sensors report coil/discrete state.

manage_entities.title: Manage entities
manage_entities.description: Select an entity to edit its configuration or remove it.

edit_sensor.title: Sensor settings
edit_sensor.description: Configure a read-only Modbus register as a Home Assistant sensor.

data_description.scale: Raw register value is multiplied by this factor. Use 0.1 for values stored as 10× integers.
data_description.state_class: Set to 'measurement' for sensors that constantly change, 'total_increasing' for energy meters.

edit_switch.title: Switch settings
edit_switch.description: Configure a Modbus coil or holding register as a Home Assistant switch.

data.name: Entity name
data.on_value: Value written for ON (holding register mode only)
data.off_value: Value written for OFF (holding register mode only)

data_description.on_value: Only used when register type is 'holding'. Ignored for coil registers.
data_description.off_value: Only used when register type is 'holding'. Ignored for coil registers.

edit_binary_sensor.title: Binary sensor settings
edit_binary_sensor.description: Configure a read-only Modbus coil or discrete input as a binary sensor (on/off state).

edit_number.title: Number entity settings
edit_number.description: Configure a writable Modbus holding register as a numeric input (slider or text box).

data_description.mode: Slider shows a draggable range control. Box shows a numeric input field.
data_description.scale: Display value = raw register value × scale.

error.no_entities: No entities are configured yet. Use 'Add a sensor or switch' first.
